# Guardify IT

Guardify IT is an e-commerce subscription marketplace in Bangladesh, providing access to digital tools, entertainment, productivity tools, and development subscriptions.

## Services Offered
- ChatGPT Plus Subscriptions
- LinkedIn Premium Subscriptions
- Canva Pro Subscriptions
- Microsoft 365 Subscriptions
- Streaming Subscriptions (Netflix, Spotify, etc.)

## Delivery
All digital subscriptions are delivered via WhatsApp within 10 to 30 minutes of order confirmation.

## Payments
Secure payment processing via mobile banking channels: bKash, Nagad, and Rocket.
